storey_count.pass_if: main block has 2 storeys visible in elevation

roof_type_pitch.pass_if: gable roof with moderate pitch (visually comparable to original ~35-40deg Federal period)

fenestration.pass_if: 3-bay main facade, double door at center bay (bay index 1), 2 windows GF flanking, 3 windows UF

massing_wing.pass_if: right-side wing present, 1-storey, proportionally smaller than main block

chimney.pass_if: 2 chimneys at END WALLS (left gable + right gable or wing junction), NOT interior ridge positions
